messages:
alex: CI alert: microbench threshold diff failed for PR #14987 on `batcher_select` path. Perf unit shows +17% median token latency in Linux-x86-prod kernel.
morgan: link to job? saw a noisy run earlier but didn't investigate. :eyes:
alex: https://ci.internal.redwood/job/14987/console - relevant snippet below\n```\nTEST: microbench/kernel_batch_select\nBASE: 1.00ms (golden)\nPR:   1.17ms (+17%)\nTHRESHOLD: 10%\nDIFF: +17.0% (FAIL)\nCPU profile: kernel_choice() spends extra cycles in `choose_preferred_kernel_v2`\n```\neng-bench-bot: Perf regression detected. Golden diff: +17.0%. Notified: @eng-runtime. Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/14987/trace.tbz
sam: quick look at the trace: the kernel hot path switches on sequence length 128 -> 256 due to new sampler heuristics in prefatch-heuristic-v2. I see an additional memcpy and a missed fastpath. Flame graph attached in artifact.
morgan: can you repro locally with the microbench? i tried `scripts/run_microbench --case=batcher_select` and got noise but not fully +17.
sam: repro command I used:\n```bash\nPYTORCH_JIT=0 taskset -c 4-7 ./bazel-bin/bench/microbench --case=batcher_select --iters=2000 --seq=256\n```\nThat reproduces median +15-18% on my devbox (A100-40GB ql).
alex: digging git log, suspicious merge is `merge: prefer-prefetch-heuristic-v2 (commit 9c3fa2b)`, merged in PR 14930 two days ago.
morgan: can we bisect quickly? CI is blocking the merge window for the release.
sam: started a quick bisect locally: revert 9c3fa2b -> perf goes back to baseline. Apply patch that toggles flag to old heuristics, perf back to -1%. So root cause is indeed the heuristic.
taylor: suggestion: short-term hotfix = gate the new heuristic behind `--enable-prefetch-v2=false` by default on CI and Dedicated. Then we can iterate on micro-optimizations.
alex: agree. I opened PR #14999 to gate the flag in CI config and added a TODO to re-enable once we fix the memcpy/fastpath. Requesting review from @sam and @morgan. Link: https://git.internal.redwood/p/r/14999
ci-deploy-bot: Deploy job queued for PR 14999. Note: this will re-run microbench suite and update goldens if pass.
morgan: once PR 14999 lands, let's run extended CI sample (50 runs) to make sure we're not masking a different regression. Also run kv telemetry; I noticed a ~3% KV hit rate drop correlated with the change in the traces.
sam: good call. I captured KV stats from the same run: `kv_hits=0.87 -> 0.84` and `avg_token_cpu=1.17ms`. Suspect the heuristic changes batching boundaries causing more cold KV lookups. I'll dig into `kv_bucket_size` interactions.
alex: OK plan: 1) land PR 14999 gating in CI 2) bisect PR 14930 for smaller fix (avoid memcpy) 3) open follow-up to refine prefetch thresholds + add microbench golden specifically for seq=256. Tagging for release hold until CI green. :lock:
taylor: thanks. If anyone needs me to revert PR 14930 entirely for the release, say and I will cut the revert, but preferred we gate.
morgan: will queue extended runs after 14999. keep us posted in this thread. :thumbsup:
alex: updated PR with perf logs + local bisect steps. cc @sam @morgan.
